summary: Flyte Aviation, Inc. (formerly Catheter Precision; NYSE American: VJET) filed an 8-K reporting an unregistered private placement under the Additional Investment Right of its March 9, 2026 Securities Purchase Agreement. Existing accredited investors agreed to buy 2,050 shares of Series C-4 Convertible Preferred at a $1,000 stated value for $2.05 million gross, expected to close on or about October 13, 2026. Conversion price is $1.00 per share, yielding up to 2,050,000 common shares, subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker (raisable to 9.99% on 61 days notice). Dawson James acted as placement agent; Section 4(a)(2)/Rule 506(b) exemption. Routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch conversion-driven dilution and any further draws on the investment right.
